jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description

Ledcor Technical Services has been building and servicing communication networks for customers across North America since 1979. Utilizing our broad expertise and experience, we customize solutions to best meet our client's needs. We act as a key partner for our clients by delivering exceptional quality, reliability, and safety in all that we do.

Join our team as a proactive and detail-driven Project Coordinator, where you’ll play a key role in managing telecom operations and project performance. This hybrid role blends coordination of field operations with cost tracking and performance analysis, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. You will collaborate with project managers, engineers, and field teams while also interfacing with clients and stakeholders.

Apply today to become a part of the Ledcor Technical Services team and take the next step in your career!

Essential Responsibilities:

Coordinate and track all phases of telecom maintenance and construction projects, including scheduling, materials, access, and closure
Maintain and update project logs, CRM systems, and Excel trackers to reflect real-time project status
Conduct weekly update calls and meetings with internal teams and clients
Generate and submit daily work-in-progress (WIP) reports and training summaries
Support project cost tracking, including labor, materials, subcontractors, and equipment
Assist in preparing cost reports, forecasts, and earned value metrics (CPI, SPI, EAC)
Utilize tools like Excel and Power BI to generate performance and status reports
Support change management processes and ensure accurate billing and documentation
Collaborate with field managers to ensure job readiness and timely project completion
Participate in stakeholder meetings and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications:

2+ years of experience in construction project coordination or construction project controls (telecommunications experience is preferred)
Familiarity with U.S. telecommunications providers and their operational protocols
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Lookups, IF Statements, etc.); Power BI and SAP experience is a plus
Understanding of project performance metrics such as CPI, SPI, and EAC
Experience with Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS) is an asset
Excellent communication and time management skills
Ability to work independently and adapt to changing priorities
Willingness to travel up to 15% to project sites or offices

Work Conditions:

This position offers the flexibility to work remotely from a home office with occasional travel to various Ledcor offices and project sites in various locations

Additional Information

Ledcor Technical Services (LTS) designs, builds, and maintains wireline or wireless networks that span North America and beyond. We are a proven leader and innovator in telecommunications network construction, maintenance, and service installation and repair.

Ledcor has been recognized as a Top 100 Inspiring Workplace in North America.

Our competitive total rewards package provides compensation and benefits that support your physical, mental and financial well-being. We offer exciting, challenging work with opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge.

Employment Equity

At Ledcor we believe diversity, equity, and inclusion should be part of everything we do. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status or any other identifying characteristic are encouraged to apply.

Our True Blue team consists of individuals from all backgrounds who contribute diverse perspectives and experiences to Ledcor. For more information about Ledcor’s Inclusion and Diversity initiatives, please visit our I&D page . Adjustments will be provided in all parts of our hiring process. Applicants need to make their needs known in advance by submitting a request via email .

All applicants must be able to show proof of eligibility to work in the United States.

Ledcor participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States. E-Verify® is a registered trademark of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security

Link to: https://www.uscis.gov/e-verify

jobs.title: Professional Services Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

Every breach, every failed audit, every new hire stuck in onboarding purgatory traces back to the same question: who has access to what — and should they?

Identity is where modern companies break. Too much access leaks data. Too little grinds the business to a halt. The organization is the industry's first Autonomous Identity Platform — software that doesn't just surface access risk, but acts on it. The company started with a self-service AppStore and grew into the critical infrastructure connecting apps, identities, and data for numerous leading technology companies. At the center is Albus, the organization's AI agent for identity — mining roles, approving access, and catching the drift humans miss.

You'll ship work that thousands of IT and security teams touch every day. You'll own problems without playbooks, because the category is being redefined in real time — by this organization.

Key Responsibilities

Own the project plan.
Maintain project plans, schedules, and status documentation; check for past-due dates and request updates; keep track of every change made to the plan.
PS Projects Dashboard upkeep
. The internal tracking looks at weekly high-level status tags, summaries, blockers/issues to escalate, and module go-live dates, all used in reporting to the Customer team as a whole and to the executive leadership team. You will work with the Head of Professional Services and the Customer Success Managers to update and share highlights and risks weekly with the teams.
Hold the team accountable.
Track deliverables, follow up before things slip — not after — and hold both customers and internal stakeholders accountable for what they've committed to.
Run a tight ship on project calls.
Build structure for recurring project calls — set the agenda, keep the discussion on topic, and don't let Solution Architects (or anyone else) wander off-track. Coordinate meeting logistics, action items, and follow-ups.
Escalate early.
Flag risks, blockers, and account changes to the Customer Success Manager before they surprise the customer relationship. Track blocker-level bugs and sales-committed feature requests tied to product needs.
Keep the RACI clean.
Define and maintain the project RACI (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed) for each engagement so everyone knows who owns what.
Report status, internally and externally.
Own weekly project plan updates, deliver a weekly status report to the Customer Success Manager and leadership, and produce both the internal status report and the client-facing progress summary for every project.
Use AI to scale the work.
Use AI/Claude skills to help manage recurring reporting and status work so updates stay consistent and timely without eating the team's bandwidth.
Track the technical footprint.
Compare the apps a customer committed to integrating against what they've actually integrated.
Build relationships that make delivery work.
Build working relationships with the internal teams supporting each engagement, and follow established project management practices and procedures.

Required Qualifications

1–3 years of relevant experience.
Project manager or project coordinator-level experience is a plus.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
You don't let things fall through the cracks.
Comfortable across multiple tools.
Project tracking, scheduling, documentation — and experience using AI tools to boost productivity and scale reporting work rather than grinding through it manually.
A natural driver of accountability.
You follow up before things slip, not after, and you're comfortable holding both customers and internal teams to their commitments.
Clear, proactive communicator.
You can run a tight, on-topic call and translate project status into something a Customer Success Manager, an internal team, or a client executive can act on immediately.

What We Value

The organization also cares about whether you would be a good fit based on the values and characteristics that define how outcomes are achieved, not just your resume.

Pay Range

$117,000-$132,000
. Note that this range is a good faith estimate of likely pay for this role; upon hire, the pay may differ due to skill and/or level of experience.

Benefits and Perks:

💻 Remote-first culture
– Work from anywhere within ±4 hours of Pacific Time.
🏥 Medical, dental & vision insurance
– 100% of premiums covered for employees, 60% for dependents. HSA and FSA available with employer contribution. International benefits align with local standards.
🧠 Mental health support
– Access to mental health resources and support.
💪 Monthly wellness stipend
– A monthly stipend for gym memberships, fitness apps, and whatever helps you recharge.
🛡️ Life & disability insurance
– Life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage available.
🌴 Flexible PTO
– Flexible time off with a minimum annual requirement, because rest is part of doing your best work.
👶 Parental leave
– Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for expecting parents.
📚 $1,000 annual learning stipend
– An annual budget for courses, books, conferences, and certifications.
✈️ Company & team offsites
– Company and team bonding trips throughout the year, fully covered by the organization.
💰 401(k) with matching
– Employer 401(k) matching to help you save for the future.

The hiring company is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator/Administrator
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Construction Project Coordinator/Administrator
Location:
On Site - Jacksonville, Florida, United States
Salary:
$50,000-$85,000 Depending on experience
Skills:
commercial, ground up, Renovations, retail, Office building, Federal, educational, Healthcare, Historic

About the Construction Company / The Opportunity:

Join a dynamic organization in the construction industry delivering commercial, renovation, retail, office, federal, educational, healthcare, and historic projects. This opportunity is ideal for an organized construction professional who enjoys coordinating project teams, managing documentation, supporting procurement, and helping ensure projects are delivered efficiently. Based on site in Jacksonville, Florida, you will work closely with Project Managers, Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, and clients throughout the project lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

Support Project Managers and Superintendents with day-to-day coordination and administrative activities across assigned construction projects.
Solicit subcontractor and vendor bids, issue RFQs, compare proposals, process purchase orders, and maintain accurate procurement and buyout logs.
Track long-lead materials, equipment deliveries, committed costs, schedules, and potential impacts to project execution.
Maintain organized project documentation, contracts, scopes of work, schedules, drawings, specifications, and project logs in Procore and related systems.
Draft, distribute, monitor, and close out RFIs and submittals while following up with subcontractors, vendors, and design professionals.
Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas and supporting materials, document action items, and follow up to support timely completion.
Manage subcontractor and vendor documentation, including contracts, insurance certificates, bonds, lien waivers, compliance records, and closeout materials.
Assist with cost tracking, value engineering, punch lists, warranties, as-built documentation, and timely project closeout.

Must-Have Skills:

3+ years of experience in construction coordination, project administration, or a closely related role.
Working knowledge of commercial construction processes, procurement, subcontract administration, and project documentation.
Proficiency with Procore for project records, RFIs, submittals, schedules, and communication.
Familiarity with Monday CRM, Sage Intacct, and Microsoft Excel.
Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Project Managers, Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, clients, and accounting teams.
Ability to track competing priorities, identify potential issues, and follow assignments through to resolution.
Professional communication skills and a proactive, solutions-oriented approach.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience supporting ground-up commercial construction or renovation projects.
Exposure to retail, office building, federal, educational, healthcare, or historic construction projects.
Experience with buyout reporting, job cost coding, forecasting, or value engineering.
Familiarity with construction schedules, short-interval planning, and long-lead procurement management.
Knowledge of subcontractor compliance requirements, including insurance, bonds, lien waivers, and closeout documentation.
Experience coordinating punch lists, warranties, operation and maintenance manuals, and as-built records.
Ability to read and navigate construction drawings, specifications, and scopes of work.

Ensure availability of data for management decision making.

Coordinate correspondence and maintain extensive filing system.

Assist with updates to the website, maintain mailing lists, file logs.
